brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The General Authority for Exhibitions & Conferences discussed strengthening the economic partnership with the Malaysian Chamber of Commerce. [1]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR MALAYSIA
The discussion on strengthening economic partnership with the Malaysian Chamber of Commerce may be affected by Malaysia's link to 44 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations. [1][E2]

KEY RISKS
Malaysia's link to 44 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations poses a risk of increased scrutiny in international trade and finance. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the discussion between the General Authority for Exhibitions & Conferences and the Malaysian Chamber of Commerce on strengthening economic partnership is unresolved. [1]
